verdict.rationale: Together AI's Dedicated Model Inference serves a model on reserved hardware, separate from serverless, with no hard rate limits. The docs show a CLI deploy command and autoscaling between configurable min/max replica bounds on a chosen metric. Fine-tuned models can also be deployed. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of dedicated endpoint isolation and autoscaling behavior.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can deploy a model on dedicated GPU capacity with autoscaling so my traffic is isolated from the shared serverless pool

citations.quote: Dedicated model inference (DMI) lets you serve a model on reserved hardware, providing several advantages over serverless models
You set the minimum and maximum replica count, and the platform autoscales between those bounds based on a metric that you choose.
